iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 45. Ceasefire Day 2 BUT FRACTURING. Enrichment dispute: Farsi text accepts enrichment, English does not. US and Israel actively wiping out nuclear expertise before winding down operations (CNN). 440kg 60% HEU trapped at Isfahan. Hormuz reclosure complicates ceasefire sustainability. IAEA still withdrawn. Trump threatens action if Tehran fails to comply. Technical: CRITICAL. Diplomatic: LOW. Probability UP to 44%. Rising.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 45. CEASEFIRE 'HANGS BY A THREAD' (AP). IRGC claims Strait of Hormuz shipping stopped. Possible mines detected in strait. Iran demanding $1/barrel crypto tolls. Only 11 vessels transited Apr 8. Trump threatens 'action' if Tehran fails to comply with ceasefire deal. Kpler: ceasefire 'may reduce immediate disruption' but situation remains critical. Mobilization: CRITICAL (Hormuz military enforcement ongoing). Probability UP to 33%. Rising.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel–Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 45. ⚠️ MAXIMUM ESCALATION: April 8 attacks now have own Wikipedia page - 254+ killed, 890+ wounded in single day. Israel's most intense bombing wave yet. HEZBOLLAH RESUMED ROCKET FIRE at 02:30 Apr 9 on Kiryat Shmona and Manara, vowing to continue until aggression ceases. UK and France calling for Lebanon ceasefire. Netanyahu: ceasefire 'does not include Lebanon'. Trump: Lebanon is 'separate skirmish'. AP: ceasefire 'hangs by a thread'. 1.1 million displaced (20% of population). Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Probability UP to 65%. RISING. Most volatile zone.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: NATO Steadfast Dart-2026 exercise underway. Patriot battery deployed to Malatya. Times of Israel analysis: Turkish nuclear weapon would be dangerous for Israel and India. FM Fidan nuclear arms race comments from March still echoing. Stable at 11%.

india.name: India–Pakistan
india.notes: US Intelligence 2026 Annual Threat Assessment: India-Pakistan 'remain a risk for nuclear conflict'. India fast breeder reactor news generating regional reactions. Pakistan missile concerns (Gabbard). No new escalatory signals. Stable at 17%.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: BREAKING: Trump-Rutte meeting concluded - NATO HOLDS. Trump vented about allies not helping in Iran war but avoided rupture. Euronews: 'NATO holds after Rutte-Trump talks amid fragile ceasefire'. NATO exit discussion tabled for now. Strategic Rocket Forces at 90% modernization. Lavrov continues nuclear rhetoric. GLOBSEC: hybrid warfare escalating. Probability DOWN slightly to 58%. Stable.

china.name: China
china.notes: DPP promoting $40B drone procurement budget (200,000 unmanned systems). KMT Chairwoman Cheng Li-wun visiting Beijing (cross-strait proxy). CNN investigation: China secretly expanding nuclear weapons infrastructure confirmed. Taiwan budget delay threatens $2.4B weapons. Technical: CRITICAL (long-term buildup). Stable at 11%.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: THIRD missile launch in 2 days (Apr 8). Multiple SRBMs from Wonsan. VP FM Jang Kum-chol: South Korea 'most hostile enemy state', called them 'world-startling fools'. Kim observed cruise missile test from new destroyer. Constitutional nuclear status 'irreversible'. Kim demands US nuclear recognition. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Technical: CRITICAL. Stable at 87%. No further escalation today but maintaining peak.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia–Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1140+. Polymarket: only 2% chance of ceasefire by April 30. Russia preparing additional Oreshnik systems. Arms Control Association: Russia concocting 'Ukrainian bomb' claims - potential pretext. New START expired Feb 2026, no replacement. Full arms race underway per Bulletin. NATO-exit wildcard reduced after Trump-Rutte meeting. Slight decrease to 82%.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: DIPLOMATIC BREAKTHROUGH SUSTAINED: China-hosted Urumqi talks concluded. Afghanistan-Pakistan agreed to 'avoid any escalation' and 'explore comprehensive solution'. Reuters: China says both sides committed to resolving differences. VP Vance delegation (incl. Kushner) heading to Islamabad this weekend - US diplomatic engagement increasing. TTP ceasefire for Eid holding. Diplomatic: HIGH. Probability DOWN to 9%. Falling.
